PaglaMLX API reference

Local LLM orchestration for Apple Silicon — sourced from the project's docs site.

● http://127.0.0.1:2525/v1
Checking gateway…
POST/v1/chat/completions

Standard OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Accepts all common parameters.

ParameterTypeDefault
modelstringrequired
messagesarrayrequired
temperaturenumber0.0
top_pnumber1.0
top_kinteger0
min_pnumber0.0
max_tokensinteger512
streambooleanfalse

Message roles: system, user, assistant, tool

Response (non-streaming)

{
  "id": "chatcmpl-xxx",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "choices": [
    {"index": 0, "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "Hello!"}, "finish_reason": "stop"}
  ],
  "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 12, "completion_tokens": 8, "total_tokens": 20}
}

Streaming response (SSE)

data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"role":"assistant"}}]}
data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hello"}}]}
data: [DONE]

Example

curl http://127.0.0.1:2525/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $(defaults read com.paglaai.app apiKey)" \
  -d '{"model":"auto","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What is MLX?"}],"stream":true}'
POST/v1/messages

Translates Anthropic-format requests to OpenAI format and back, so Claude Desktop and other Anthropic-native clients can talk to local models.

ParameterTypeNotes
modelstringModel name, auto, or routing prefix
messagesarrayAnthropic-format messages
systemstringSystem prompt, top-level field
max_tokensintegerRequired by Anthropic's spec
streambooleanEnable SSE streaming

Content blocks (text, image) and tool calls translate bidirectionally: Anthropic tool_use ↔ OpenAI tool_calls; Anthropic tool_result ↔ OpenAI tool role.

Streaming response (SSE, Anthropic format)

data: {"type":"content_block_start","content_block":{"type":"text","text":""}}
data: {"type":"content_block_delta","delta":{"type":"text_delta","text":"Hello"}}
data: {"type":"message_stop"}

Example

curl http://127.0.0.1:2525/v1/messages \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $(defaults read com.paglaai.app apiKey)" \
  -d '{"model":"auto","max_tokens":1024,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello!"}]}'
GET/v1/models

Lists models currently loaded and running as mlx_lm.server processes. Model IDs match directory names in your models directory.

{"object":"list","data":[{"id":"Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-4bit","object":"model"}]}
GET/v1

Health check. Returns {"status":"ok"} when the gateway is running.

On every request, the gateway checks these in order and stops at the first match.

  1. Local exact match — model name is a key in ~/.paglamlx/routes.json
  2. Local substring match — name contains, or is contained in, a local route key
  3. Prefix-based cloud routing — see table below
  4. Free Router — if enabled in Settings → Cloud, falls through to OpenRouter
  5. Session stickiness — reuses this session's previous backend, if any
  6. Local default fallback — first available local model
  7. 503 — nothing matched
PrefixRoutes toNeeds key
gpt-, o1, o3OpenAIOPENAI_KEY
claude-AnthropicANTHROPIC_KEY
gemini-GeminiGEMINI_KEY
openrouter/OpenRouterOPENROUTER_KEY
groq/GroqGROQ_KEY
together/Together AITOGETHER_KEY

Auto-Router (model: "auto") picks a local model by: multimodal need → long context need → coder/math keyword intent → your configured default.

Sends a real request to your gateway, if PaglaMLX is running on this machine and this page is opened in a browser that can reach localhost.
